items.e: I will not allow you to use my pen.
items.z: 我不允许你用我的钢笔。

items.e: I have no idea why she got so angry.
items.z: 我不知道她为什么如此生气。

items.e: I saw a man get hit by a car.
items.z: 我看到有个男人被车撞了。

items.e: I'd love to find out why she said so.
items.z: 我很想找出她为什么这么说的原因。

items.e: All you need to do is just sit here.
items.z: 你要做的只是坐在这儿。

items.e: I don't go in for that sort of thing.
items.z: 我讨厌那种事。

items.e: Do you still want to give me a hug?
items.z: 你还想拥抱我一下吗？

items.e: How many apples do you want me to buy?
items.z: 你想让我买多少个苹果？

items.e: You may as well tell me all about it.
items.z: 你不妨告诉我一切。
